home.faqTitle: Frequently asked questions about Khiva tours
home.faqSubtitle: Planning a trip to Khiva or Uzbekistan? Start here.

faqs.q: What are the best Khiva tours for first-time visitors?
faqs.a: Most guests start with a Khiva city tour inside Itchan Kala (Ichan Kala), then add a Khorezm day trip to Ayaz-Qala, Toprak-Qala and the Ellik Qala fortresses. We help you choose private or shared options.

faqs.q: Are you a licensed Khiva travel agency?
faqs.a: Yes. Khiva Shodlik Travel is a Khiva-based travel agency offering excursions, transfers and multi-day Uzbekistan tours with English-speaking drivers and licensed local guides on request.

faqs.q: Do you offer Khiva walking tours and day tours?
faqs.a: We organize Khiva walking tours through the old city, museum visits, minarets and madrasahs, plus half-day and full-day tours to ancient Khorezm and the Aral Sea region.

faqs.q: Can I book a private guide in Khiva?
faqs.a: Private Khiva excursions with a dedicated driver (and guide on request) are available year-round. Contact us with your dates and group size for a custom quote.

faqs.q: Do you run Aral Sea tours from Khiva?
faqs.a: Yes. Our Aral Sea tours from Khiva include Muynak, the ship cemetery, Ustyurt canyons and desert landscapes — typically as 1–3 day packages with comfortable transport.

faqs.q: What should I do in Khiva for one or two days?
faqs.a: Day one: UNESCO Itchan Kala city tour. Day two: Khorezm fortresses or a Silk Road transfer to Bukhara or Nukus. See our Khiva tours and Uzbekistan tours pages for itineraries.

about.metaDescription: Meet Khiva Shodlik Travel — local Khiva travel agency for Uzbekistan tours, Khiva excursions, transfers and Aral Sea adventures since day one.
about.intro: We are a Khiva-based travel agency helping visitors discover Itchan Kala, ancient Khorezm and the wider Silk Road.

khivaTours.metaTitle: Xiva turlari va ekskursiyalar | Xiva agentligi
khivaTours.metaDescription: Book Khiva tours, walking tours, Ichan Kala excursions and Khiva city tours with a local travel agency. Private guide, day tours & UNESCO sights.
khivaTours.intro: Explore UNESCO Itchan Kala, turquoise minarets and ancient Khorezm with a trusted Khiva travel agency. We offer private and shared Khiva tours, walking tours and custom day trips.

sections.heading: Khiva city tours & walking tours
sections.p1: Our Khiva city tour covers palaces, mosques, the Kalta Minor minaret and hidden corners of the old town with a knowledgeable local guide or driver.
sections.p2: Choose a relaxed Khiva walking tour at sunrise or sunset, or combine museums and craft workshops for a full-day Ichan Kala tour.

sections.heading: Khorezm day tours from Khiva
sections.p1: Beyond the walls, popular Khiva excursions visit Ellik Qala, Ayaz-Qala, Toprak-Qala and desert landscapes — the classic Silk Road fortress route.
sections.p2: Shared day trips start from competitive per-person rates; private tours offer flexible timing and hotel pickup.

sections.heading: Why book with a local Khiva travel agency?
sections.p1: We live in Khiva, speak English, and plan realistic routes with modern vehicles — sedan, SUV, minivan or bus for groups.
sections.p2: WhatsApp support, transparent pricing and fast confirmation make us a top choice for Uzbekistan tours starting in Khiva.

khivaTours.ctaSubtitle: Tell us your dates and we will recommend the best Khiva tour or private excursion.
khivaTours.faqSubtitle: Answers about booking, timing and sights.

faqs.q: How long is a typical Khiva city tour?
faqs.a: Most Khiva walking tours and city tours take 3–6 hours inside Itchan Kala, depending on museums and photo stops.

faqs.q: Is Itchan Kala (Ichan Kala) included?
faqs.a: Yes — our Khiva UNESCO tour focuses on the walled inner city, its architecture and key monuments.

faqs.q: Can I combine Khiva tours with Bukhara or Samarkand?
faqs.a: We arrange transfers and multi-city Uzbekistan tour packages — ask for a Silk Road itinerary.

faqs.q: Do you offer Khiva day tours year-round?
faqs.a: Spring and autumn are ideal, but Khiva excursions run in all seasons with adjusted start times in summer heat.

faqs.q: What is the best tour in Khiva for photography?
faqs.a: Sunrise walks on the walls and Kalta Minor, plus golden-hour routes through narrow alleys are guest favorites.

faqs.q: How do I book Khiva excursions?
faqs.a: Browse our tour list, use the booking form, or message us on WhatsApp for instant confirmation.

uzbekistanTours.metaDescription: Uzbekistan tours and packages from Khiva — Khorezm, Bukhara transfers, Aral Sea, Silk Road tours Uzbekistan. Local Uzbekistan travel agency.
uzbekistanTours.intro: Start your Uzbekistan tour in Khiva — the gateway to Khorezm, Karakalpakstan and the classic Silk Road cities. We design private and group routes across Uzbekistan.

sections.heading: Silk Road tours Uzbekistan
sections.p1: Link Khiva with Bukhara, Samarkand and Tashkent via reliable transfers and guided stops. We handle timing, border-free domestic travel and luggage-friendly vehicles.
sections.p2: Popular Silk Road tours Uzbekistan packages combine UNESCO old towns with desert fortresses and local meals.

sections.heading: Khorezm & northwest Uzbekistan
sections.p1: Our Uzbekistan tours highlight ancient Khorezm, the Ellik Qala chain, Nukus museums and the Aral Sea shoreline.
sections.p2: Multi-day options include yurt stays and photography-focused routes.

sections.heading: Custom Uzbekistan travel agency service
sections.p1: As a Khiva travel agency we tailor Uzbekistan tours for families, couples, photographers and small groups.
sections.p2: English support, hotel pickup in Khiva and 24/7 WhatsApp assistance are included.

uzbekistanTours.ctaSubtitle: From a single transfer to a 10-day Silk Road tour — we will help you plan it.

faqs.q: Can I start Uzbekistan tours in Khiva?
faqs.a: Yes — Khiva is our base. Most guests arrive from Urgench airport or train, then continue to Bukhara or Nukus.

faqs.q: Do you offer Uzbekistan group tours?
faqs.a: We run shared day tours and can connect you with private multi-day Uzbekistan tour plans.

faqs.q: What visas do I need for Uzbekistan tours?
faqs.a: Check current visa rules for your nationality. We provide invitation letters on request for certain visa types.

faqs.q: How many days for Khiva and Khorezm?
faqs.a: Allow 2–3 days for Khiva city plus one Khorezm day trip; add 1–2 days for Aral Sea or Nukus extensions.

faqs.q: Are Silk Road tours Uzbekistan suitable in winter?
faqs.a: Winter is quieter with cool weather; some desert roads need extra time — we advise daily.

faqs.q: How to book Uzbekistan tours with your agency?
faqs.a: Contact us with dates and interests — we reply with options and clear pricing.

aralSeaTours.metaDescription: Aral Sea tours from Khiva — Muynak, ship cemetery, Ustyurt canyons. Multi-day Uzbekistan adventure with a local Khiva travel agency.
aralSeaTours.intro: Discover the Aral Sea region — Muynak's ship cemetery, dramatic canyons and desert roads — on guided tours departing from Khiva with experienced drivers.

sections.heading: Classic Aral Sea tour from Khiva
sections.p1: Most Aral Sea tours from Khiva are 1–2 day trips to Muynak and viewpoints over the former shoreline, with stops for photos and local lunch.
sections.p2: Longer routes add Ustyurt Plateau canyons and Nukus for the Savitsky Museum.

sections.heading: What to expect on the road
sections.p1: Desert highways, seasonal tracks and bright skies — we use air-conditioned SUVs or minivans and carry water.
sections.p2: Start times are early in summer; spring and autumn offer the best light for photography.

sections.heading: Combine with Khiva tours
sections.p1: Pair an Aral Sea tour with a Khiva city tour and Khorezm fortresses for a complete northwest Uzbekistan itinerary.
sections.p2: We handle hotel pickup in Khiva and drop-off on return.

aralSeaTours.ctaTitle: Request an Aral Sea tour quote
aralSeaTours.ctaSubtitle: Share your travel dates and group size for a tailored program.

faqs.q: How far is Muynak from Khiva?
faqs.a: The drive is several hours across Khorezm and Karakalpakstan — we plan rest stops and safe driving hours.

faqs.q: Is the Aral Sea tour from Khiva worth it?
faqs.a: Travelers interested in environmental history, surreal landscapes and off-the-beaten-path Uzbekistan tours love this route.

faqs.q: Do I need a 4x4 for Aral Sea tours?
faqs.a: Most seasons are fine in SUV/minivan; we monitor road conditions and adjust the route if needed.

faqs.q: Can I visit the ship cemetery?
faqs.a: Yes — Muynak's ship cemetery is a highlight of our standard Aral Sea package.

faqs.q: How many days for an Aral Sea tour?
faqs.a: One day is possible for highlights; two days allow canyons and museum visits.

faqs.q: Who operates Aral Sea tours from Khiva?
faqs.a: Khiva Shodlik Travel organizes private and small-group departures with local drivers who know the region.
